erasure: The Heaven's gaze turns cold. {name}'s cultivation scatters like windblown ash — the Heavenly Dao has erased them, and they fall back to Mortal.
There is no thunder, no lightning. Only a silence deeper than the void, and then: {name} stands on mortal ground, qi gone, remembering nothing but a whisper of power.
The Dao has spoken. {name} is returned to 凡人 (Mortal) — but the soul remembers 25% of its 悟性 (comprehension), a treasure no erasure can take.
Ashes drift from {name}'s sleeves as they rise from the ground, marked with the title 'Ashen Remnant'. The Heavens have not killed them — only unmade them.
A merchant finds {name} wandering the mortal road, dazed, qi-less. Yet something ancient glints in their eyes: past-life wisdom that no tribulation can burn away.
The world forgets {name} for a single breath. When it remembers, they are Mortal once more — but they have stared into the face of Heaven and lived to cultivate again.
